name: khelben "blackstaff" arunsun
lore:
The Lord Mage of Waterdeep is less a man and more a permanent fixture of the city’s arcane ecology. He dwells within Blackstaff Tower, a monolithic spire that acts as the North’s primary conductor for the Weave. Khelben does not inhabit the wilds; he is the apex predator of the urban magical landscape, maintaining the city's defenses like a stern gardener tending a lethal thicket.

His behavior is defined by a cold, impenetrable pragmatism. He views the world through the lens of centuries, making him appear detached or even manipulative to shorter-lived races. He speaks only when necessary, his voice carrying the resonance of ancient power. Do not mistake his stillness for apathy; he is the architect of a thousand unseen victories. To cross him is to invite the focused wrath of Mystra’s chosen—a force as inevitable as the tide.
